brief.title: Established
brief.text: Before I can put your name on a requisition, the Bureau needs to see an operating corporation: a registered office on this station and five people on your payroll. The Charter Round is judged on production, {{ceoName}}, not on paperwork alone.

objective.label: Reach Corporation Level 1: an office and five employees

done.text: Good. {{corpName}} exists on paper and in the corridors. Come up to Deck 7.

brief.title: Deck 7
brief.text: Every corporation chartered this year was chartered for a reason: the incumbents hold leases and leave them idle while the ISA's construction depots wait on material. I have a silicate requisition that has been open for eleven days. Take it, and show the Bureau that the Round was not a mistake.

objective.label: Accept the Silicate Requisition Order in the Assignments Bureau

done.text: It is on your books. Four hundred units of silicates, delivered to my office. There is no deadline on it; there is a record.

brief.title: A claim and a yard
brief.text: Silicates come out of the ground, and the ground needs a lease. The Claims & Leases Division will file an Earth claim for a corporation with five employees. Put a Basic Extractor Yard on it.

objective.label: Hold a mining lease on Earth and build a Basic Extractor Yard

done.text: A claim and equipment. Now make it produce.

brief.title: Production
brief.text: Start a cycle on the Earth yard. The throughput is your decision: run it hard and the requisition fills sooner, but the operating cost comes out of your reserves every hour. I would rather you delivered late than went insolvent on my contract.

pending.label: Your Earth cycle ends
pending.payoff: Silicates in your Earth Station Prime stock

done.text: It is running. Silicates will accrue at Earth Station Prime while you do other things.

brief.title: While it runs
brief.text: A cycle is a wait. Spend it. Queue Basic Extraction Analytics in Corporate R&D: two hours, and every yard you ever run extracts ten percent more. It is also one of the two things the ISA wants to see before it confirms your charter at Level 3.

done.text: Queued. You now have two things finishing without you. That is how this job works.

brief.title: Delivery
brief.text: When four hundred units are in your Earth Station Prime stock, bring them to the Bureau. Deliver from the station where the silicates are.

objective.label: Deliver 400 Silicates on the Silicate Requisition Order

done.text: Received, counted and logged. Twelve thousand credits are on their way to your account, and your name is on the Bureau's list of corporations that deliver.

letter.subject: Requisition 4-7A: delivery confirmed

brief.title: Trade
brief.text: A corporation that only delivers to the ISA is a contractor. Sell silicates on the Galactic Exchange: the GEX standing order settles at once at its posted price, or you can list for another corporation to buy.

objective.label: Sell 300 Silicates on the Galactic Exchange

done.text: Production, delivery, trade. One more thing before I can file your confirmation.

brief.title: Mars
brief.text: The Charter Round counts production on Mars, where the ISA wants new capacity. The Mars Orbital Dock files Mars claims, and the claims office there will want five more employees on your payroll for a second lease. Travel takes about fifteen minutes from here.

objective.label: Hold a mining lease on Mars (Corporation Level 2)

hints.text: Hire to ten first: five per lease.
Travel to the Mars Orbital Dock.

pending.label: You arrive at the Mars Orbital Dock

done.text: Two claims on two worlds. That is a corporation.

brief.title: Confirmation
brief.text: The review needs your corporation at Level 3: the silicates sold and the analytics researched. When both are on your record, I file.

done.text: Filed. {{corpName}} is a confirmed charter of the 2147 Round. I have more requisitions than I have operators I trust. Come and see me when the next ones post.

letter.subject: Charter Round 2147: confirmation of {{corpName}}
